items.title: 52035_Eddie Durham oral history interview
items.q: he had the black guys in the band, see. That's it, he had a black band. So that's when I played the guitar

ctx.x: Well, when do you sort of begin to play professionally, out of the family band?

That's when I went with -- well, it was one incident left out there, which was Doug Morgan's dramatic show. That's when I travelled with four brothers. And just before -- in between there, just before I got involved with (inaudible).
Keep your voice up a bit.
